Syncthing source and license notice
===================================

KiteSync Node includes Syncthing v2.1.3, built from the unmodified
upstream source at commit 946e2b83a1f6c6ae119427c09e0a5802940b82ff.

Source repository: https://github.com/syncthing/syncthing
Pinned source: https://github.com/syncthing/syncthing/tree/946e2b83a1f6c6ae119427c09e0a5802940b82ff
License: Mozilla Public License 2.0 (MPL-2.0)

The corresponding license text is distributed as SYNCTHING_LICENSE.txt.
KiteSync does not modify the pinned Syncthing source. It builds Syncthing with
the noupgrade tag so updates remain under KiteSync's signed release process.

The complete license and notice texts for external Go modules linked into the
supported Syncthing binaries are distributed as THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt. Their
versions, replacements, target membership, and license-file hashes are recorded
in SYNCTHING_GO_MODULES.json.
